name: Ember Cleave
description: Attacks one enemy with a burning blade, with a 50% chance to inflict Burn for 2 turns.

name: Rally Cry
description: Grants Attack Up to all allies for 2 turns and pushes their initiative by 20%.

name: Pyre Judgment
description: Strikes all enemies with a 75% chance to lower Defense for 2 turns.

name: Frost Needle
description: Attacks one enemy with a 35% chance to inflict Speed Down for 1 turn.

name: Glacial Prison
description: Attacks one enemy and has a 70% chance to Stun for 1 turn.

name: Winter's End
description: Unleashes a blizzard on all enemies, with a 60% chance to inflict Speed Down for 2 turns.

name: Root Smash
description: Attacks one enemy. Damage increases with the caster's max Health.

name: Barkskin
description: Grants Defense Up to all allies for 2 turns and Provokes the enemy with the highest Attack.

name: Earthen Bulwark
description: Grants Immunity to all allies for 2 turns and heals them for 15% of their max Health.

name: Gleam
description: Attacks one enemy and heals the ally with the lowest Health for 10% of their max Health.

name: Dawn Mantle
description: Heals all allies for 25% of their max Health.

name: Sunrise Choir
description: Heals all allies for 20%, grants Speed Up for 2 turns, and pushes initiative by 30%.

name: Shadow Nick
description: Attacks one enemy with a 40% chance to inflict Bleed for 2 turns.

name: Fade Step
description: Grants self Critical Up for 2 turns and pushes own initiative by 50%.

name: Gravewhisper
description: A devastating strike on one enemy. Inflicts Heal Block for 2 turns.

name: Thorn Shot
description: Attacks one enemy. 30% chance to lower Attack for 1 turn.

name: Volley
description: Attacks all enemies.

name: Deadeye
description: Attacks one enemy with a guaranteed critical hit.

name: Club Swing
description: Attacks one enemy.

name: Heavy Swing
description: Attacks one enemy with extra force.
